caseName: New York Central Securities Corp. v. Cleveland, Cincinnati, Chicago & St. Louis Railway Co.
caseNameFull: New York Central Securities Corporation v. Cleveland, Cincinnati, Chicago and St. Louis Railway Company and New York Central Railroad Company
attorneys: Mr. Frederick A. Henry for appellant., Mr. S. H. West for appellees, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment of dismissal herein by the district court for want of jurisdiction is reversed on the authority of General Investment Co. v. New York Central Railroad Co., 271 U. S. 228.
